title: A root session's MCP bridge lacks the delegation tools (spawn_session, get_session_status/result, resume_after_delegations) while other sessions on the same host have them
outcome: A root session's MCP bridge lacks the delegation tools (spawn_session, get_session_status/result, resume_after_delegations) while other sessions on the same host have them
acceptance: The cause of Termal::Sol-1cee's (session-13169) active bridge exposing mailbox, review_identity and resume_after_test_runs but not termal_spawn_session, termal_get_session_status/result or termal_resume_after_delegations is identified
A root session gets the full delegation tool set, or a clear typed reason why it is withheld, without a config edit or session replacement; a test covers the identified path
